projects.title: Comprehensive Healthcare Analytics
projects.description: End-to-end healthcare analytics on patient, billing, doctor, and appointment data — SQL (SSMS) for cleaning and referential-integrity checks, Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) for analysis, and Power BI dashboards surfacing billing trends, doctor performance, and patient demographics.
projects.longDescription: End-to-end healthcare analytics on patient, billing, doctor, and appointment data — SQL (SSMS) for cleaning and referential-integrity checks, Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn) for analysis, and Power BI dashboards surfacing billing trends, doctor performance, and patient demographics.

projects.title: U.S. Healthcare Industry Analysis
projects.description: Power BI analysis of the U.S. healthcare industry (2019–2020) — modeling patient demographics, hospital performance, and payer–provider dynamics with DAX measures and interactive filters for scenario modeling and executive reporting on a dimensional (star-schema) model.
projects.longDescription: Power BI analysis of the U.S. healthcare industry (2019–2020) — modeling patient demographics, hospital performance, and payer–provider dynamics with DAX measures and interactive filters for scenario modeling and executive reporting on a dimensional (star-schema) model.

projects.title: Healthcare Data Analysis with Power BI
projects.description: Interactive Power BI dashboard on hospital visitor data — patient demographics, visit timing, department referrals, and satisfaction scores — built with Power Query ETL, data modeling, and DAX KPIs to support resource optimization and patient-care decisions.
projects.longDescription: Interactive Power BI dashboard on hospital visitor data — patient demographics, visit timing, department referrals, and satisfaction scores — built with Power Query ETL, data modeling, and DAX KPIs to support resource optimization and patient-care decisions.

projects.title: Insurance Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Power BI dashboard for insurance policy and claims data — modeling premium, platinum, and basic policy types, claim vs. no-claim behavior, and risk factors such as smoker status, with DAX measures surfacing underwriting and portfolio insights.
projects.longDescription: Power BI dashboard for insurance policy and claims data — modeling premium, platinum, and basic policy types, claim vs. no-claim behavior, and risk factors such as smoker status, with DAX measures surfacing underwriting and portfolio insights.

projects.title: SQL for Financial Data Analysis
projects.description: SQL-based financial reporting system generating Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports from general-ledger, chart-of-accounts, territory, and calendar datasets — with pivoted, period-over-period and country-level breakdowns validated against Excel.
projects.longDescription: SQL-based financial reporting system generating Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, and Cash Flow reports from general-ledger, chart-of-accounts, territory, and calendar datasets — with pivoted, period-over-period and country-level breakdowns validated against Excel.

projects.title: Mutual Fund Analysis Dashboard
projects.description: Screened 2,500+ mutual-fund schemes down to the top 30 high-return, low-risk funds using Python (Pandas, scikit-learn MinMaxScaler) with a custom scoring model on returns, expense ratio, and fund age — presented in a professional Power BI dashboard.
projects.longDescription: Screened 2,500+ mutual-fund schemes down to the top 30 high-return, low-risk funds using Python (Pandas, scikit-learn MinMaxScaler) with a custom scoring model on returns, expense ratio, and fund age — presented in a professional Power BI dashboard.

projects.title: HeartAI — Clinical Data Analytics Pipeline
projects.description: Delivered an analysis-ready clinical dataset to a healthcare AI team by consolidating fragmented PostgreSQL records into a tested dbt + Snowflake medallion pipeline, catching schema and null-value issues in staging before they reached the models downstream teams relied on.
projects.longDescription: Delivered an analysis-ready clinical dataset to a healthcare AI team by consolidating fragmented PostgreSQL records into a tested dbt + Snowflake medallion pipeline, catching schema and null-value issues in staging before they reached the models downstream teams relied on.

projects.title: DRIP — Financial Risk Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Production risk-intelligence platform scoring 100 monitored assets and $124B+ exposure across drawdown, volatility, concentration, and liquidity — automating threshold alerting in Python and surfacing breaches in real time through Tableau dashboards instead of period-end review.
projects.longDescription: Production risk-intelligence platform scoring 100 monitored assets and $124B+ exposure across drawdown, volatility, concentration, and liquidity — automating threshold alerting in Python and surfacing breaches in real time through Tableau dashboards instead of period-end review.

projects.title: Customer Churn Prediction
projects.description: Telco churn analysis combining statistical testing (t-tests, chi-square) with scikit-learn classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, KNN) to identify churn drivers and predict at-risk customers at ~81% accuracy, translated into retention recommendations.
projects.longDescription: Telco churn analysis combining statistical testing (t-tests, chi-square) with scikit-learn classifiers (logistic regression, random forest, KNN) to identify churn drivers and predict at-risk customers at ~81% accuracy, translated into retention recommendations.

projects.title: Retail Margin Cockpit
projects.description: Governed retail margin and inventory model — a dbt star schema (DuckDB / Postgres) with tested marts feeding a Power BI semantic layer (DAX + row-level security) that exposes category-level margin gaps invisible in siloed spreadsheets.
projects.longDescription: Governed retail margin and inventory model — a dbt star schema (DuckDB / Postgres) with tested marts feeding a Power BI semantic layer (DAX + row-level security) that exposes category-level margin gaps invisible in siloed spreadsheets.

projects.title: OCD Patient Data Analysis
projects.description: Analyzed a 1,500-patient OCD dataset with SQL for feature engineering and data-quality fixes, then built interactive Power BI dashboards visualizing clinical and demographic patterns to support treatment decisions.
projects.longDescription: Analyzed a 1,500-patient OCD dataset with SQL for feature engineering and data-quality fixes, then built interactive Power BI dashboards visualizing clinical and demographic patterns to support treatment decisions.

projects.title: Field Ops SQL Cost Audit
projects.description: Field-service cost-to-serve and SLA-breach analysis in dbt / SQL — recursive CTEs to reconstruct route order, window functions for rolling technician utilization, and an independent hand-verified test set validating the breach logic.
projects.longDescription: Field-service cost-to-serve and SLA-breach analysis in dbt / SQL — recursive CTEs to reconstruct route order, window functions for rolling technician utilization, and an independent hand-verified test set validating the breach logic.

projects.title: Order Fulfillment SLA Monitor & Seller Scorecard
projects.description: Traced a customer-review-score drop to seller handoff delay and carrier transit variance across 99K marketplace orders in SQL, replacing lagging monthly review with a weekly Power BI SLA scorecard with drill-through from breach to individual order.
projects.longDescription: Traced a customer-review-score drop to seller handoff delay and carrier transit variance across 99K marketplace orders in SQL, replacing lagging monthly review with a weekly Power BI SLA scorecard with drill-through from breach to individual order.

projects.title: HR Analytics Dashboard
projects.description: Data-driven dashboard visualizing workforce trends and employee attrition patterns, turning HR data into actionable insight for retention and headcount decisions.
projects.longDescription: Data-driven dashboard visualizing workforce trends and employee attrition patterns, turning HR data into actionable insight for retention and headcount decisions.

projects.title: Apple App Store Insights
projects.description: SQL analysis of an App Store dataset uncovering how pricing, genre, language support, and description length relate to ratings — finding that paid apps and 10–30 language support correlate with higher ratings.
projects.longDescription: SQL analysis of an App Store dataset uncovering how pricing, genre, language support, and description length relate to ratings — finding that paid apps and 10–30 language support correlate with higher ratings.

projects.title: OSHA Safety Intelligence Dashboard
projects.description: NLP and predictive modeling on OSHA injury narratives to predict hand injuries and surface machine-related safety trends, paired with an interactive Power BI dashboard for safety insights.
projects.longDescription: NLP and predictive modeling on OSHA injury narratives to predict hand injuries and surface machine-related safety trends, paired with an interactive Power BI dashboard for safety insights.

projects.title: Stock Price Prediction
projects.description: Stock-price forecasting with TensorFlow and scikit-learn — data preprocessing, visualization, and a model forecasting prices 28 days ahead, evaluated with RMSE.
projects.longDescription: Stock-price forecasting with TensorFlow and scikit-learn — data preprocessing, visualization, and a model forecasting prices 28 days ahead, evaluated with RMSE.

projects.title: Car Dealership Analytics
projects.description: Interactive dashboard predicting car prices, segmenting customers, and optimizing inventory using Python, R, Streamlit, and ML models — with dynamic pricing trends and customer clustering.
projects.longDescription: Interactive dashboard predicting car prices, segmenting customers, and optimizing inventory using Python, R, Streamlit, and ML models — with dynamic pricing trends and customer clustering.
